title: Trips tied to jobs
description: The route and the purpose of the visit can be checked before they go into the figures.

blocks.text: One author complains that trips between work addresses are logged incompletely. Tying them to a job is only any use once the route itself has been saved and the person has been able to check for gaps.

quote.text: The mileage tracking only works about 30 percent of the time. So you will be wasting most your day going back and manually inputting the locations you have been. When you are a contractor and go multiple places a day very inconvenient.

blocks.text: Show the sequence of trips and the gaps with nothing logged, and allow the addresses and the purpose of the visit to be corrected. Then tie the chosen leg to a job and decide separately whether it goes into what the client is charged.
Don’t add a second log kept by hand

Check whether the tool cuts down the evening spent reconstructing addresses. If the automation misses trips often, adding categories and a good-looking report will increase the work instead of reducing it.
